title: Mumvuri uri shure kwechigaro choumambo
intro: Munomira mukati mematare eumambo hwekare hwakasimba, uko mutongi ane simba akazviti ndiye mwari pamusoro pevanhu vese. Padivi pemutongi uyu pane muranda akazvipira, akapiwa zvinangwa zvikuru zveumambo. Pamwe chete, vanoronga uye vanoronga, vachiramba kuteerera yambiro yenhume yakatumwa kuzovatungamirira. Munogona here kuziva kuti muranda uyu akatendeka aive ani?
clues: Ndaigara muumambo hwakasimba hwaitongwa nemunhu ane simba aizviti ndiMwari pamusoro pevanhu vese.
Ndakashanda semufundisi aivimbwa naye wemutongi uyu, ndichizadzisa zvese zvavaida uye zvavairayira.
Mutumwa waAllah paakauya kunyika yedu achitidana kuti tizive chokwadi, ini nemutongi wangu takaramba kuteerera.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndibatidze moto mukuru uye ndigadzire zvidhinha zvevhu kuti zvivakwe zvakanaka.
Mutongi wangu aida kuvaka chivako chakareba zvekuti chaisvika kudenga pacharo.
Pakupedzisira, mutongi wangu, mauto edu, neni takatorwa tikanyura pasi pegungwa.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
